hebrewText: זְכֹ֤ר עֲדָתְ/ךָ֨ קָ֘נִ֤יתָ קֶּ֗דֶם גָּ֭אַלְתָּ שֵׁ֣בֶט נַחֲלָתֶ֑/ךָ הַר צִ֝יּ֗וֹן זֶ֤ה שָׁכַ֬נְתָּ בּֽ/וֹ

tokens.bdb: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention;  to be male
tokens.kjv: [idiom] burn (incense), [idiom] earnestly, be male, (make) mention (of), be mindful, recount, record(-er), remember, make to be remembered, bring (call, come, keep, put) to (in) remembrance, [idiom] still, think on, [idiom] well.

tokens.bdb: a stated assemblage (specifically, a concourse, or generally, a family or crowd)
tokens.kjv: assembly, company, congregation, multitude, people, swarm. Compare H5713 (עֵדָה).

tokens.bdb: to erect, i.e. create; by extension, to procure, especially by purchase (causatively, sell); by implication to own
tokens.kjv: attain, buy(-er), teach to keep cattle, get, provoke to jealousy, possess(-or), purchase, recover, redeem, [idiom] surely, [idiom] verily.

tokens.bdb: the front, of place (absolutely, the fore part, relatively the East) or time (antiquity); often used adverbially (before, anciently, eastward)
tokens.kjv: aforetime, ancient (time), before, east (end, part, side, -ward), eternal, [idiom] ever(-lasting), forward, old, past. Compare H6926 (קִדְמָה).

tokens.bdb: to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property, marry his widow, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] in any wise, [idiom] at all, avenger, deliver, (do, perform the part of near, next) kinsfolk(-man), purchase, ransom, redeem(-er), revenger.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property
tokens.enLiteralWord: to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property
tokens.explanation: to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property
tokens.explanationEn: to be the next of kin (and as such to buy back a relative's property

tokens.bdb: a scion, i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan
tokens.kjv: [idiom] correction, dart, rod, sceptre, staff, tribe.

tokens.bdb: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion
tokens.kjv: heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare H5158 (נַחַל).

tokens.bdb: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.enLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanation: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanationEn: a mountain or range of hills

tokens.bdb: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
tokens.kjv: he, [idiom] hence, [idiom] here, it(-self), [idiom] now, [idiom] of him, the one...the other, [idiom] than the other, ([idiom] out of) the (self) same, such (a one) that, these, this (hath, man), on this side...on that side, [idiom] thus, very, which. Compare H2063 (זֹאת), H2090 (זֹה), H2097 (זוֹ), H2098 (זוּ).

tokens.bdb: to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: abide, continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-er), have habitation, inhabit, lay, place, (cause to) remain, rest, set (up).
